answer: Full-time shore staff receive 21 working days of annual leave per calendar year after 6 months probation.
context: Full-time shore-based staff receive 21 working days of paid annual leave per calendar year after completing the 6-month probation period.

answer: Up to 10 unused annual leave days may be carried over into the next year.
context: Up to 5 unused annual leave days may be carried over into the following calendar year if used before March 31.

answer: A medical certificate is required if sick leave lasts 3 or more consecutive working days.
context: Shore staff are entitled to 10 paid sick leave days per calendar year. Absence of 3 or more consecutive working days requires a medical certificate submitted to HR within 2 days of returning to work.

answer: Primary caregivers receive 16 weeks of paid parental leave and secondary caregivers receive 4 weeks.
context: Primary caregivers receive 16 weeks of paid parental leave, and secondary caregivers receive 4 weeks of paid parental leave within 12 months of birth or adoption.

answer: Bereavement leave is 10 working days for immediate family members.
context: Employees are granted 5 working days of paid bereavement leave in the event of the death of an immediate family member.

answer: Flights under 6 hours require economy class, and trips over USD 1,500 need written manager pre-approval.
context: All business trips estimated above USD 1,500 require written manager pre-approval at least 7 days prior to booking. Economy-class airfare is mandatory for all flights under 6 hours.

answer: Hotel caps are USD 180 for domestic travel and USD 240 for international travel, and business-class flights are allowed over 4 hours.
context: Hotel nightly rate caps are USD 180 for domestic travel and USD 240 for international travel. Economy-class airfare is mandatory for all flights under 6 hours. Premium economy may be approved for single-leg flights exceeding 6 hours.

answer: The daily meal per diem is USD 65 per full travel day, and receipts must be submitted within 14 calendar days.
context: The daily meal per diem is USD 65 per full travel day. Itemized receipts must be submitted in the expense portal within 14 calendar days of trip return.

answer: Employees may accept supplier gifts up to USD 50, while cash gifts are prohibited.
context: Staff may not accept gifts, hospitality, or favours from suppliers exceeding USD 50 in value. Cash or cash equivalents of any amount are strictly prohibited.

answer: Suspected policy breaches must be reported to the HR Ethics Hotline within 48 hours.
context: Suspected harassment, safety violations, or policy breaches must be reported to the HR Ethics Hotline or Compliance Officer within 48 hours.

answer: Nordic Marine Supply charges a 15% restocking fee on unused returns within 30 days and offers Net 30 payment terms.
context: Unused stock returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery subject to a 15% restocking fee. Standard invoice terms are Net 30 days from bill of lading date.

answer: Nordic Marine Supply provides a 24-month warranty on all OEM spare parts.
context: All OEM parts carry a 12-month warranty from the date of vessel installation or 15 months from shipment, whichever occurs first.

answer: Pacific Spares Ltd applies an automatic 5% bulk discount on orders exceeding USD 5,000.
context: Orders exceeding USD 5,000 in total merchandise value receive an automatic 5% bulk discount prior to freight.

answer: Pacific Spares Ltd offers free air freight delivery to all European ports within 24 hours.
context: Pacific Spares Ltd ships EXW Singapore or DDP major Asian and Middle East ports.

answer: Rubber seals and gaskets from Pacific Spares Ltd carry a 6-month warranty.
context: Propulsion and main engine components carry an 18-month operational warranty. Rubber seals, O-rings, and gaskets carry a 6-month warranty.
